create_covariance_module: create a CovarianceModule with an isotropic covariance function, scale parameter, and scale prior
compute_covariance_forward: compute the scaled covariance matrix for coordinates and errors using CovarianceModule forward pass
create_cross_covariance_module: create a CrossCovarianceModule to compute cross-covariance between training and test coordinate sets
compute_cross_covariance_forward: compute the scaled cross-covariance matrix between training and test data using CrossCovarianceModule
create_diagonal_covariance_module: create a DiagonalCovarianceModule to compute diagonal covariance using diagonal probability product kernels
